name: hero-play
setup: window.__M.setMode('play'); window.scrollTo(0,0);

name: hero-edit
setup: window.__M.setMode('edit'); ['settings','effectsPanel','spectrumPanel','presetsPanel','midiPanel'].forEach(function(id){var d=document.getElementById(id); if(d) d.open=(id==='settings');}); var u=document.querySelectorAll('.unit'); u[0].open=true; u[1].open=false; u[2].open=false; u[3].open=false; window.scrollTo(0,0);

name: topbar
setup: window.__M.setMode('edit'); window.scrollTo(0,0);

name: transport
setup: window.scrollTo(0,0);

name: pad-tone
setup: var M=window.__M, p=M.padTone; p.pos={x:p.w*0.46,y:p.h*0.44}; M.apply(p); p.dirty=true; p.draw(); M.updateReadouts();

name: pad-fx
setup: var M=window.__M, p=M.padFx; p.pos={x:p.w*0.58,y:p.h*0.52}; M.apply(p); p.dirty=true; p.draw();

name: pad-env
setup: var M=window.__M, p=M.padEnv; p.pos={x:p.w*0.36,y:p.h*0.60}; M.apply(p); p.dirty=true; p.draw();

name: pad-motion
setup: var M=window.__M, p=M.padTone; p.pos={x:p.w*0.30,y:p.h*0.62}; var pts=[]; for(var i=0;i<=48;i++){var t=i/48; pts.push({t:t*2.4, dx:Math.sin(t*6.2832)*p.w*0.22, dy:-Math.sin(t*12.5664)*p.h*0.16});} p.motion={kind:'recorded',dur:2.4,dx:0,dy:0,pts:pts}; p.auto=M.startAuto(p,p.pos); M.updateMotionUI(); M.setPadPaused(p,true); var k=pts[14]; p.pos={x:p.auto.x0+k.dx, y:p.auto.y0+k.dy}; M.apply(p); p.dirty=true; p.draw();

name: pad-tone-spread
setup: var M=window.__M,$=function(i){return document.getElementById(i);}; var p=M.padTone; M.setPadPaused(p,false); p.motion=null; p.auto=null; M.updateMotionUI(); $('voices').value='12'; $('voices').dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); $('spread').value='46'; $('spread').dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); p.pos={x:p.w*0.46,y:p.h*0.44}; M.apply(p); p.dirty=true; p.draw();

name: scope
setup: window.__M.setMode('edit');

name: sound-voice
setup: var $=function(i){return document.getElementById(i);}; $('settings').open=true; var u=document.querySelectorAll('.unit'); u[0].open=true; u[1].open=false; u[2].open=false; u[3].open=false; $('voices').value='7'; $('voices').dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); $('spread').value='34'; $('spread').dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));

name: sound-units-folded
setup: var u=document.querySelectorAll('.unit'); u[0].open=false; u[1].open=false; u[2].open=false; u[3].open=false;

name: sound-pitch
setup: var $=function(i){return document.getElementById(i);}; var u=document.querySelectorAll('.unit'); u[1].open=true; $('tune').value='-3'; $('tune').dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); $('fine').value='18'; $('fine').dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); $('tuneTarget').value='9'; $('tuneTarget').dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));

name: sound-env
setup: var u=document.querySelectorAll('.unit'); u[1].open=false; u[2].open=true;

name: sound-filter
setup: var $=function(i){return document.getElementById(i);}; var u=document.querySelectorAll('.unit'); u[2].open=false; u[3].open=true; document.querySelector('[data-keyfollow="0.5"]').click(); $('filterQ').value='72'; $('filterQ').dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));

name: spectra-panel
setup: var $=function(i){return document.getElementById(i);}; $('settings').open=false; $('spectrumPanel').open=true; var n=document.querySelectorAll('.spec-controls'); for(var i=0;i<n.length;i++) n[i].style.display='none'; window.__M.specToggle('tape'); window.scrollTo(0,0);

name: spectra-module
setup: var m=document.querySelector('[data-spec="tape"]'); m.querySelector('.spec-controls').style.display=''; var t=m.querySelector('.spec-toggle'); if(t && t.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true') t.click(); var h=m.querySelector('.spec-help'); if(m.querySelector('.spec-controls .note').hidden) h.click();

name: spectra-black
setup: window.__M.specToggle('tape'); var m=document.querySelector('[data-spec="black"]'); m.querySelector('.spec-controls').style.display=''; var t=m.querySelector('.spec-toggle'); if(t && t.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true') t.click(); window.__M.specToggle('black');

name: effects-rack
setup: var $=function(i){return document.getElementById(i);}; window.__M.specToggle('black'); $('spectrumPanel').open=false; $('effectsPanel').open=true; var c=document.querySelectorAll('.fx-controls'); for(var i=0;i<c.length;i++) c[i].style.display='none'; window.scrollTo(0,0);

name: fx-delay
setup: var m=document.querySelector('[data-fx="delay"]'); m.querySelector('.fx-controls').style.display=''; var t=m.querySelector('.fx-toggle'); if(t.getAttribute('aria-expanded')!=='true') t.click();

name: fx-delay-sync
setup: var b=document.getElementById('delaySyncBtn'); if(b && b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')!=='true') b.click();

name: presets
setup: var $=function(i){return document.getElementById(i);}; $('effectsPanel').open=false; $('presetsPanel').open=true; window.scrollTo(0,0);

name: file
setup: var $=function(i){return document.getElementById(i);}; $('presetsPanel').open=false; $('midiPanel').open=true; window.scrollTo(0,0);

name: keyboard
setup: document.getElementById('keysBtn').click();

name: about-build
setup: document.getElementById('keysBtn').click(); document.getElementById('aboutBtn').click();
